reviews.t: Didn't turn on after 3 sets of batteries.
reviews.x: I don't believe that these are all verified purchases.I tried 3 different sets of batteries from different packages and none worked. A red light went on which isn't mentioned in the directions. It's too much money to spend and then the hassle of returning.

reviews.t: Simply A-M-A-Z-I-N-G
reviews.x: No lie, I have not cleaned my brushes in over a year, I had no clue some of my brushes were white! I thought they were all brown or black, this thing is amazing! I soaked the brushes in the bowl for about 30 minutes with the cleansing soap, then I cleaned each one separately, I had to rinse out the water a couple times but, I have never seen my brushes this clean except for the day I bought them!! reviews.t: Yes Buy it!
reviews.x: It works well for the price. Kit is sturdy and yes I would re-purchase and or purchase as gift. I tried cleaning all if my brushes,  but some of my brushes (mostly real technique black bottoms brushes ) were too thick to fit mainly the bigger Powder fluffy brush. All in all I like it and it's worth the money. It cuts down cleaning time and drying.

reviews.t: Works great, very pleased
reviews.x: Works great, very pleased.  Worked well for all brushes except my large fluffy brush for loose powder (still needed to clean that one by hand after using this device).  Was most impressed by its ability to clean my foundation brush - that one is usually the hardest for me to clean myself and this tackled it like a champ.

reviews.t: It’s ok
reviews.x: It’s ok. The little sleeves for the brushes don’t fit perfectly onto the spindle, so the brushes wobble a little bit when they’re spinning. I don’t feel like it gets my brushes any cleaner than when I do it by hand, but I do love how quickly they dry when you spin off all the water.

reviews.t: Not for me
reviews.x: I really wanted to love this product. I am a makeup junkie. Cleaning my makeup brushes is such a tideous task I hate doing it. Some of my brushes barely fit in the barrels that were provided and I didn't feel like it got my brushes clean. It kind of defeats the purpose.

reviews.t: Perfect cleansing and drying
reviews.x: Saw this as Facebook ad so I figured I check it out. Basin is plastic so no breakage of glass if accidentally dropped. Whisper quiet motor with perfectly sized handle attachemnts to fit variety of brushes. This washed AND DRIED my Ulta brushes perfectly!

reviews.t: Worked great!
reviews.x: Worked great!  Love it!  Cleans really well. And I love th spin dry, it removed so much moisture. The only issue is some of the collars didn’t fit great, but not enough to deduct stars. Would definitely recommend it!

reviews.t: It's really great for drying them though
reviews.x: This doesn't really clean my make-up brushes. I have to clean them separately, but I use to the give them an extra rinse. It's really great for drying them though! Definitely beats just laying them out to dry.

reviews.t: To put the brushes in the socket is very hard ...
reviews.x: To put the brushes in the socket is very hard to do. My husband even had a hard time connecting it.

reviews.t: Good product, but not really for deep cleaning.
reviews.x: I'm happy with the purchase, as it dries my brushes in about 5 seconds flat. That said, it doesn't really deep clean, as I hand washed one of my brushes after washing it with this and was surprised by how much makeup had still been left behind. Also, some of my brushes have tapered handles, and the rubber attachments this comes with doesn't really work so well with them. Like I said, though, I'm happy with the purchase and I think this will work really well if you are doing in-between washes onc

reviews.t: Garbage. Worked for ten minutes.
reviews.x: I’ll preface this with the fact that I saw the bad reviews but I fell for the fact that there were some pretty great reviews. One word to describe this product? Garbage. So I used it for maybe 10 minutes and it worked pretty decently. It got the four brushes I washed pretty clean (not clean as you would if you used a brush cleaning mat). However, I turned it off and took it to my room to actually put it to the test and it wouldn’t spin anymore. You could see that it was on but it would not spin.

reviews.t: That's pretty much all it's good for
reviews.x: Meh, this didn't clean my brushes very well. They still had makeup and soap in them after washing/rinsing them. I ended up having to wash my brushes by hand and then only using this to rinse them in clean water and to dry them up. That's pretty much all it's good for. The batteries also died right away so it eats up all the battery juice. I wouldn't recommend. This is too expensive for what's its worth. I'd value this at $19.99. The cup is also very plastic. Ladies can do this with a hand drill

reviews.t: So easy to use
reviews.x: Omg!!! I just got this today, I have been dying to try this to clean my brushes. I am so impressed!! I just cleaned and dryer all my brushes in five minutes. So easy to use, saved me a ton of time cleaning my brushes, I have never been so impressed. Definitely going to buy and give as gifts as well.

reviews.t: Meh.It works. Sort of.
reviews.x: I purchased this as a gift for a friend. She said it works. I gets the brushes clean. It even dries  them. But they spin so fast that your brushes end up getting all fanned out and frayed looking.  You could probably shape them back, but I think long-term it would be really hard on your brushes.

reviews.t: I tried it for the first time yesterday and loved how quickly it cleaned my brushes
reviews.x: This was a Christmas gift for my teenager. I tried it for the first time yesterday and loved how quickly it cleaned my brushes. Thankfully I found a good fit for every brush size.  I was amazed at how quickly they dried after washing. Great product!

reviews.t: Hand washing is much more effective and just as time consuming
reviews.x: Was very excited for this but it did not clean as well as an old fashioned hand washing. Maybe for looser brushes it would work, but my compact brushes for my eye makeup it did not clean well at all. I am returning the item.

reviews.t: Great way to clean your brushes quickly
reviews.x: Great way to clean your brushes quickly.  I had to do my foundation brush twice but that was to be expected. It return my brushes back to the original condition. Love this!!

reviews.t: it looks like is going to break any moment
reviews.x: It cleans the brushes, my only complain is that is kind of cheap, I don't know if going to last much, it looks like is going to break any moment.

reviews.t: Worked okay.
reviews.x: Worked okay. I had to keep changing the water inside and wash my brushes more than once to get it to work

claims.text: Many reviewers say it cleans brushes very effectively, often removing residue they couldn't get by hand.
A common complaint is that some brushes, especially larger or thicker ones, don't fit the provided collars/sockets well or at all.
Reviewers frequently praise the spin-dry function for drying brushes quickly.
Some reviewers report it doesn't deep clean and they still need to hand-wash afterward.
A few reviewers report durability or power problems, including units that stopped spinning or didn't turn on.
